f60421cfb4b9c75c31bc35c3c4271decb59efee1.LogDescription: Speak with Ak'Zeloth in the Barrens.
f60421cfb4b9c75c31bc35c3c4271decb59efee1.QuestDescription: Since the last great war when the Burning Legion was defeated, I have searched for sources of demonic corruption in orc society.  The collar you brought me confirms my fears.$B$BIt belongs to the Burning Blade, a cult that rallies around an item of demonic power.  It is called the Demon Seed, and it resides in the Barrens atop Dreadmist Peak.  It must be destroyed!$B$BGo to Far Watch Post, on the border of the Barrens to the west, and speak with my assistant, Ak'Zeloth.  He will direct you further.

f6c4c99b8ba941082152632370a108662f5c8e67.QuestDescription: The Blacksilt murlocs on the southwestern coast are curious creatures. In some ways, they act barely sentient, yet in others, they show a remarkable degree of organization.$B$BI have a few theories about that, but no real way to test them until recently. I've devised a method that will allow me to track the murlocs I'm interested in without doing any lasting harm or interfering with their natural behavior. If you're willing to help with the marking, I'll gladly pay you for your assistance.

f6c631f9d8e2a08976d4da5d2820488c50cca60c.LogDescription: Bring Thule's Head to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
f6c631f9d8e2a08976d4da5d2820488c50cca60c.QuestDescription: Now is the time to assault the Scourge's place of strength in Silverpine: Fenris Isle.$B$BYou must again go to the Isle and destroy Thule Ravenclaw.  I want his head!$B$BThis mission is as dangerous as it is vital, $N.  You must not fail.

An experienced mystic can use incense made from it to seek wisdom from the spirits of the ancestors.$B$BSeek out the shaman known as Grumbald One-Eye. He should carry the herb for his devotions to Ursoc.

f6ded89656b2bd64368948f3127b530ae49d84e9.QuestDescription: So Kurgatok is certain Dugar is being held in Veil Shalas? That's the largest of the arakkoa settlements that we know of.$B$BVeil Shalas is in the far south of the forest, close to the eastern rim of the Bone Wastes.
